method.name: GPT Public-Research-First H776 parity crosscheck
order: pinned Hebrew text and direct Genesis context
public theological/study-note resources as context-only controls
Korean candidate source-fidelity and theological-overreach filter
rules: Lexical meaning is not expanded from devotional or theological application.
Translation gloss diversity alone does not create a new lexical sense.
BDB/source hierarchy and morphology/context boundaries must remain inspectable, as in H776 erets.
Public theological resources may challenge or contextualize a candidate but cannot override stronger lexical/corpus evidence.
No Approval Registry, approved meaning, production, quality gate, license gate, or main mutation is allowed in this report.

publicEvidenceConvergence: BDB/Strong converge on motion or direction toward as the core prepositional function.
Independent public outlines also preserve hostile direction, reference/concerning, rule/standard, and occasional positional/presence uses.
Genesis WLC examples confirm direction-to-person/place as a dominant concrete control.
requiredBeforePromotion: Preserve a visible BDB-derived sub-boundary for according-to/rule-standard use instead of hiding it in generic Korean particles.
Preserve occasional presence/near/among class where supported by the BDB node hierarchy, but do not promote each Korean particle to an independent lexical sense.
Keep hostile-direction and concerning/reference uses distinct from simple physical motion.

publicEvidenceConvergence: BDB defines a general particle/sign of relation, not merely an adjectival relative-clause marker.
Public BDB/Strong witnesses preserve who/which/that plus temporal, local, manner, causal and content-clause/conjunctional functions.
BDB explicitly notes temporal/local/causal relations and later conjunction-like use approximating ki; compound prepositional constructions still require separate construction-level handling.
items.recommendedHeadKo: 관계·접속 표지: ~하는·~인·~것; 문맥에 따라 때·곳·이유·내용 관계
requiredBeforePromotion: Do not reduce the lemma to a relative-clause-only gloss.
Retain relative, temporal/local, and conjunctional/content relations as bounded grammatical functions under one relational particle hierarchy.
Keep בַאֲשֶׁר, כַּאֲשֶׁר, מֵאֲשֶׁר and similar combinations as construction-level evidence rather than multiplying standalone lexical senses.

publicEvidenceConvergence: BDB/Strong converge on whole/all as the core, with all/every/any/each arising under scope and construction.
Public concordance evidence supports totality, distributive and indefinite renderings without requiring unrelated lexical senses.
requiredBeforePromotion: Keep construct/article/syntactic scope attached to each usage note.
Do not infer a theological meaning of total sovereignty from the quantifier itself; that belongs to passage-level theology.

publicEvidenceConvergence: BDB/Strong converge on Qal come/go/enter and Hiphil cause/bring, with Hophal passive brought/introduced.

Public BDB outlines preserve context-bounded extensions such as arrive, come upon, come to pass and attain, which should remain subordinate to stem and construction rather than flattened into the headword.
requiredBeforePromotion: Retain explicit Qal sub-boundaries for enter/arrive/come-go and context-bound event/attainment uses where BDB supports them.
Retain Hiphil causative and Hophal passive hierarchy separately.
Do not let the Hiphil-heavy early Genesis sample redefine the lemma globally.

publicEvidenceConvergence: Public BDB/Strong sources converge on simple/absolute negation as the lexical-grammatical core.
Translations such as never, none, without and cannot are constructional/contextual outcomes and do not require independent lexical senses.
requiredBeforePromotion: Keep negation scope in syntax/context, not in proliferated gloss senses.
Do not derive covenantal or moral theology from the particle itself.

publicEvidenceConvergence: BDB/Strong converge on third-person singular he/she/it, with neuter reference.
Public lexical outlines also preserve emphatic/self, resumptive/subject-focus, demonstrative that/this, and occasional copular functions.
requiredBeforePromotion: Add explicit demonstrative and emphatic/resumptive functional boundaries to the inspectable hierarchy.
Keep copular renderings as grammatical function and do not treat every English/Korean copula as a standalone lexical meaning.

publicEvidenceConvergence: Public BDB/Strong sources agree that the headword is the proper name Jacob and, beyond personal reference, can denote his descendants/national Israel by context.
Heel/supplant etymological explanations belong to etymology/provenance and narrative wordplay, not the primary proper-name meaning.
requiredBeforePromotion: Keep personal Jacob and collective/national Jacob context-distinct.
Keep heel/supplant wordplay in provenance/notes rather than replacing the headword gloss.

publicEvidenceConvergence: BDB/Strong public sources converge on literal brother with wider kinship, countryman/community and affinity/resemblance extensions.
Possessive suffix variation is morphology and participant reference, not new lexical sense.
requiredBeforePromotion: Preserve literal sibling, wider male kin, and community/affinity extensions as context-bounded layers.
Keep suffix-person distinctions outside the lexical sense inventory.

items.currentCandidateHeadKo: 낳다·출산하다·자식을 두다; 어간에 따라 태어나다·낳게 하다
publicEvidenceConvergence: Public BDB/Strong sources converge on bear/bring forth, causative beget, passive born, midwife-related and lineage uses.
Genesis concordance controls show female birth and genealogical begetting, confirming the need to bind Korean rendering to stem, subject role and context.
requiredBeforePromotion: Maintain Qal, passive stems, Piel midwife use and Hiphil/genealogical causative boundaries.
Do not convert covenant/barrenness/redemption themes from study notes into lexical senses of yalad.

publicEvidenceConvergence: BDB/Strong converge on year as the time-unit core.
Age, duration, annual and yearling-like renderings are governed by number, construction and context rather than unrelated lexical senses.
requiredBeforePromotion: Keep age/duration/annual expressions construction-bound.
Chronological or covenantal significance belongs to passage-level theology, not the lexical headword.
